sections.appearance: Ichika has straight, black, waist length hair with a pair of long sidebangs on the front. She wears two different hair pins on the left side of her hair. She has blueish-grey eyes, and a pair of black-feathered angel wings. Halo ==== Her halo is a pair of two red circles, one smaller than the other, with four arrows pointing from the center towards four outward directions, seemingly forming a crosshair. Uniform ==== She wears the usual Justice Realization Committee uniform - A black sailor shirt with a red strip on the pleated skirt and sleeves, and a red armband, the word "Justice" imprinted on it, and a red ribbon with choker on the neck. A pair of black shortgloves are found on her hands. She wears a pair of black shoes and socks along with the uniform. Firearm ==== She uses a black Enfield EM-2 experimental bullpup assault rifle with red furniture.

sections.personality: A seemingly calm and laid-back girl who doesn't seem to show much concern on most occasions. At best, she only mentions what's wrong with the situation because most of the time, the situation deteriorates before she can intervene. However, behind those closed eyes of hers lies a destructive personality that lays hidden until Ichika's patience breaks. In these instances, she goes into a frenzy to rival Tsurugi in raw strength and destructive potential, and she works very hard to keep this side of herself contained.
